display_long_description:
Transform your way of working with Mixed Reality and facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams.

Harbor Player serves as an enterprise-grade platform, enabling to effortlessly manage, secure, and deploy assets at large scale, and deliver rich, interactive and efficient business experiences. Synergiz Harbor Player addresses various use cases, such as training, complex data visualization, product presentations, augmented tours, interior design, and more.

- Seamlessly visualize and manipulate 3D elements and multimedia content, integrating them contextually with your real environment

- Provide users with advanced functionalities to organize, link and animate 2D and 3D assets and thus create attractive presentations for better user engagement and information retention

- Import your MS Guides projects into Harbor Platform, and play them in your Quest

- Enhance real-time collaboration, whether remote or in the same room, to streamline business operations and boost overall performance.

Take it a step further with the premium version of Harbor Player, which enables real-time manipulation of multiple 3D objects and multimedia elements, annotation, and access to advanced functions like collision detection, occlusion, measurements, 1:1 scale, cross-sections, model explosions, and more.

If any questions, contact the sales team at contact@welcometoharbor.io.
